title: Chapter 224: Flame Horse
content:
Chapter 224: Flame Horse

Wang Shuo came to the stable of the cavalry camp again.

He immediately received 100 flaming war horses.

10 stallions and 90 mares.

Wang Shuo smiled mischievously.

I don’t know if these stallions can bear this 1:9 ratio!

Each of the 100 war horses was shiny and sleek, with fine hairs like flames all over their bodies. If it weren’t for the upgrade of the second-level barracks, the original stables couldn’t hold so many war horses.

Wang Shuo took out an ordinary war horse and stood together. The ordinary war horse was half a head shorter than the flaming war horse.

The momentum emanating from the flaming war horse made the ordinary war horse feel uncomfortable and couldn’t help wanting to stay away from them.

Each flaming horse had a horse tag hanging around its neck, which could be stored in the horse tag.

Wang Shuo noticed at this time that these war horses actually needed to eat.

Wang Shuo ordered someone to bring some food, and the flaming war horse immediately started eating.

[Flame Warhorse: Level 2 monster, agility 50, 1 times the speed of an ordinary warhorse, stronger endurance, and twice the charge ability of an ordinary warhorse. ]

Incredible!

A groom who delivered the food immediately said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, these monster warhorses need to be fed with energy crystals for the best effect."

When Wang Shuo heard this, his heart was slightly shocked.

Okay, here comes another big consumer of energy crystals.

According to the groom, a warhorse needs to consume 1 energy crystal a day. If it is a mare, it is best to consume two energy crystals a day.

This can speed up the breeding of foals.

"Okay, you will need to regularly go to Duan Zongguan to withdraw the energy crystals you need to feed in the future!"

Back at the lord's mansion, Wang Shuo thought of his reward, and there were two mines.

[Saltpeter Mine: You can collect saltpeter. ]

[Level 2 Gold Mine: You can collect a large amount of gold ore, which can be used to cast equipment. 】

This is a good thing. In Wang Shuo's blacksmith shop, there are a lot of gold equipment that need to be made, and there is a lack of gold ore.

Just when Wang Shuo was smiling.

The space around Wang Shuo seemed to be imprisoned.

The figure of Lord Zak appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

"Wang Shuo, congratulations on winning the first place in Changping County!"

When Wang Shuo heard this, he thought of his fifth place in Hedong County.

Wang Shuo forced a smile and asked: "Lord Zak, you are not here to congratulate me!"

Lord Zak put away his smile and said seriously: "I am here to tell you that you have a great opportunity now."

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows and showed a hint of interest.

"The Lord of Sunset City in the Outer Domain is very optimistic about you and wants you to join his army."

Wang Shuo was surprised.

"Of course, in return for your joining his territory, he will now give you a big resource package."

"What restrictions do I have to join his army, and what are the benefits?"

Wang Shuo asked with a puzzled face.

"Well, as a player I am very optimistic about, I will tell you in person."

"Join his army, you will naturally be his subordinate and obey his orders. Although he is still outside the domain and cannot give you orders in person, you will meet when the time is right."

"Can I refuse?"

"Of course, but don't you want to hear about the resources he gave you for the initial investment?"

Wang Shuo did not speak.

Master Zak, with a sharp gaze, stared at Wang Shuo.

Then he said slowly: "One level 3 iron mine, one level 3 gold mine, one senior blacksmith, one senior architect, one senior doctor, 1 million energy crystals, 5 senior general job transfer certificates, 2 senior military advisor job transfer certificates..."

Wang Shuo's breathing became rapid.
